actions.title: Register your complaint on the National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal
actions.why: Report Women/Child Related Crime — includes child sexual abuse material and sexually explicit content; anonymous reporting is offered for child sexual abuse material.
steps: Open cybercrime.gov.in and choose 'Report Women/Child Related Crime' (you may report anonymously).
Copy each prepared block from the Complaint page into the matching portal field.
Attach the files marked 'portal-ready'. Keep the full evidence package for the police.
After submitting, write down the acknowledgement number and record it here.
A portal complaint is not an FIR. You can also go to your local police station (a Zero FIR can be filed at any station).

clock.label: Suggested time to check the complaint status (not a legal deadline)

actions.title: Report the post(s) to Blog [DEMO]
actions.why: 1 live location(s) on Blog [DEMO]. A report to the platform is what actually gets content taken down, and its reply starts a deadline you can enforce.
steps: Contact the site's abuse address, then the hosting provider's abuse contact (shown under domain intelligence).
Paste the prepared text below into the report form (choose the 'intimate / non-consensual' or 'impersonation' reason if offered).
Save the confirmation / ticket number the platform shows or emails you, and record it here.
If the platform does not act in time, escalate to its India Grievance Officer.
actions.prepared_text: I am the person depicted (or reporting on their behalf). The following content is intimate/sexual imagery created without consent using AI manipulation. Please remove it and preserve related account data. URLs: http://127.0.0.1:8765/blog/2026/10/viral-photo-explained. Under India's IT Rules 2021, intermediaries are expected to act promptly on complaints about intimate or impersonating (including artificially morphed) content.

clock.label: Intimate, morphed or impersonating content - complaint by the person shown
clock.basis: IT Rules 2021 Rule 3(2)(b), as amended in 2026 (previously 24 hours)

actions.title: Block re-uploads with StopNCII.org
actions.why: StopNCII creates a digital fingerprint of the image on YOUR device (the image is never uploaded) so participating platforms can block copies. It accepts AI-made intimate images of you if you are 18+.
steps: Open StopNCII.org on your own phone or computer.
Select the image from your device - it is fingerprinted locally.
Save the case number and PIN it gives you; record the case number here.

clock_sources.note: Confirm the current rule text. Some summaries disagree on dates; a later draft amendment (30 Mar 2026) may also apply.

disclaimer: This is a guide to the official routes, not legal advice. You submit every report yourself; this app only prepares the material and keeps your record.
